name: T3 Code
description: T3 Code is an open-source control surface for coding agents. It provides a web interface for orchestrating Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build and OpenCode sessions from remote devices.

app_vars.name: var_t3_providers
app_vars.label: Provider CLIs
app_vars.help: Optional comma-separated values: codex, claude, grok, opencode. Authentication is always manual. Cursor is supported by T3 Code but is not installed automatically because its upstream installer is not compatible with community-scripts helper requirements.

app_vars.name: var_t3_version_control
app_vars.label: Version Control
app_vars.help: Set to none to skip Git installation.

app_vars.name: var_t3_source_control
app_vars.label: Source Control CLIs
app_vars.help: Optional comma-separated values: github, gitlab, azure. Authentication is always manual.

notes.text: The service runs as the dedicated non-root t3 user. T3 Code data and runtime state are stored in /opt/t3-code_data so updates do not remove user data.
Provider and source-control CLIs are optional. Selected CLIs are installed for the t3 user but are not authenticated automatically; the required pct exec commands are printed after installation.
Cursor is supported by T3 Code but is not installed by this script because its upstream installer is a remote shell script. Install Cursor CLI separately for the t3 user if required.

A one-time pairing URL with a one-hour lifetime is generated and printed at the end of installation. Generate another one inside the container with npx --yes t3@latest pair --base-dir /opt/t3-code_data --ttl 1h. Treat pairing links as passwords.
The service listens on all interfaces at TCP port 3773 over HTTP. Restrict access to a trusted network or place it behind HTTPS before exposing it beyond your private network.
The arm64 path has not been tested yet. Native node-pty dependencies may require a successful build on the target architecture.
